input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products (standing ventures brief)
errors: Moved eval/bowling-lane-table.py while solver workers still called it by __file__; restored a copy until they finished.
pysat 1.9's CaDiCaL raises NotImplementedError on interrupt(), so solve_limited with a timer cannot cap time; switched to one subprocess per season with a timeout.

doc_friction.issue: Two sessions were sent to the same flagship item within minutes (PR 17107 opened 4 min before this run's PR 17108); this run had already built a repair search and half a SAT table before claim_check showed the overlap. The 'open your draft PR before you read further' step was followed late here (after ~20 min of experiments), which is on this run.
Its threading.Timer + solve_limited time limit does not work with the installed python-sat (CaDiCaL interrupt unsupported); a long check runs unbounded.

deviations.why: claim_check said YIELD to PR 17107 on the same item (bowling's 6 misses). Work was already under way.
deviations.did: Dropped this run's search and solver-table engine changes (same idea as 17107's walk + table) and narrowed the PR to a part 17107 does not do: SAT proofs that 44 seasons cannot be even, with the page and engine saying so. That holds whichever search lands.
deviations.result: No overlapping engine code; small textual conflict possible in bowling.mjs imports when 17107 merges.

writeups: ventures/league-schedule-generator/README.md (Bowling: seasons where an even lane split is proved impossible)
notes: Swept 900 seasons (4-32 teams x 1-60 round-robin weeks); 145 missed by a polish+min-conflicts-repair search; CaDiCaL verdicts: 44 UNSAT, 17 SAT, 84 UNKNOWN (20-150 s per season). Pattern: W = P (season as long as the lane pairs) UNSAT for every n from 4 to 30; 4 teams UNSAT for W = 2,3,4 mod 6 to 58. Tried and dropped this session: min-conflicts tabu (closed 10x30, 12x30, 18x26, 24x34 but not 16x32 or 20x30), full-neighbourhood tabu and SA (stalled at 4-14 off), per-block perfect rotation (impossible: P consecutive circle rounds never deal evenly, the same fact the proofs show), cyclic-shift-only deals (82-92 off at 20x30). Local checks: node --test bowling.test.mjs page.test.mjs 66 pass; run_venture_tests league-schedule-generator: ok, 590 tests, 216.6 s; venture-preflight: first run failed check_cli_entry on eval/bowling-bound-sweep.mjs's file:// guard (fixed with pathToFileURL), second run clean.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an OR engineer: SAT encoding, a 900-season sweep, 145 solver runs, engine flag, page copy and a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
